error.invalid_identity: The appliance identity could not be verified.

abort.reconfigure_mismatch: The new endpoint belongs to a different appliance.

init.title: WOLF CWL-2 runtime policy
init.description: Choose control authority, polling intervals in seconds, and optional register tiers.

data.allow_appliance_reset: Allow the guarded appliance reset action

error.invalid_interval: Every interval must be at least 5 seconds.

identity_mismatch.title: WOLF CWL-2 appliance identity changed
identity_mismatch.description: The live appliance no longer matches a configured entry. Reconfigure that entry to the correct gateway endpoint, or remove and add the appliance again.

corrupt_store.title: WOLF CWL-2 stored data is invalid
corrupt_store.description: A WOLF CWL-2 entry cannot load its Home Assistant-owned desired state or profiles. Restore Home Assistant from a known-good backup, or remove and add the affected entry to create new storage.

unsupported_store.title: WOLF CWL-2 stored data is from a newer version
unsupported_store.description: A WOLF CWL-2 entry uses a storage schema this integration cannot read. Install the integration version that created the data; do not edit the storage file manually.
